library(dplyr)
library(magrittr)
library(randomForest)
library(tibble)






# 4.1. Import Data for RF


data_dir <- "C:/Users/peter/OneDrive/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Gene/data"
raw_data_dir <- "C:/Users/peter/OneDrive/Documents/UCSF/raw_data"
results_dir <- "C:/Users/peter/OneDrive/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Gene/results"

# Import metadata
metadata_df_with_folds <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "metadata_df_with_folds.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F)



# Number of RF trees
ntrees <- as.numeric(Parameters["RF Trees", "Count"])

# Import LASSO-selected genes
lasso_fold_coefs <- read.csv(
  file.path(results_dir, "lasso_fold_coefs.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F)

lasso_fold_coefs_n3 <- read.csv(
  file.path(results_dir, "lasso_fold_coefs_n3.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F)

lasso_fold_coefs_n1 <- read.csv(
  file.path(results_dir, "lasso_fold_coefs_n1.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F)

# Outcome variable
y <- factor(
  metadata_df_with_folds$LRTI_adjudication,
  levels = c("No Evidence", "Definite")
)

# Number of outer folds
nfolds <- max(metadata_df_with_folds$fold)








# 4.2. RF function


# Run Random Forest using a specified set of fold-specific features
run_rf_classifier <- function(selected_coefs, classifier_name) {
  
  cv_list <- lapply(seq_len(nfolds), function(test_fold) {
    
    set.seed(8634782 + test_fold)
    
    # Features selected for this outer test fold
    keep <- selected_coefs %>%
      filter(fold == test_fold) %>%
      pull(gene) %>%
      unique()
    
    # Define training and test samples
    train <- metadata_df_with_folds$fold != test_fold
    test  <- metadata_df_with_folds$fold == test_fold


    # Load VST matrices generated using this outer fold
    vsd_train_mat <- readRDS(
      file.path(
        data_dir,
        paste0("vsd_train_fold", test_fold, ".rds")
      )
    )

    vsd_test_mat <- readRDS(
      file.path(
        data_dir,
        paste0("vsd_test_fold", test_fold, ".rds")
      )
    )


    # Check that selected genes are present
    stopifnot(
      all(keep %in% rownames(vsd_train_mat)),
      all(keep %in% rownames(vsd_test_mat))
    )


    # Confirm VST samples match the expected outer fold
    stopifnot(
      all(
        colnames(vsd_train_mat) ==
        metadata_df_with_folds$sample_name[train]
      ),
      all(
        colnames(vsd_test_mat) ==
          metadata_df_with_folds$sample_name[test]
      )
    )


    # Convert VST matrices to samples x genes
    X_train_all <- t(as.matrix(vsd_train_mat))
    X_test_all  <- t(as.matrix(vsd_test_mat))


    # Keep only selected features
    X_train <- X_train_all[, keep, drop=F]
    X_test  <- X_test_all[, keep, drop=F]
    
    # Fit RF on training samples only
    rf <- randomForest(
      x = X_train,
      y = y[train],
      ntree = ntrees
    )
    
    # Predict held-out test fold
    preds <- predict(
      rf,
      newdata = X_test,
      type = "prob"
    )[, "Definite"]
    
    list(
      test_fold = test_fold,
      mod = rf,
      pred = preds
    )
  })
  
  # Collect out-of-fold predictions
  rf_preds <- bind_rows(
    lapply(cv_list, function(x) {
      data.frame(
        sample_name = metadata_df_with_folds$sample_name[
          metadata_df_with_folds$fold == x$test_fold
        ],
        pred = x$pred,
        stringsAsFactors=F
      )
    })
  ) %>%
    left_join(
      metadata_df_with_folds %>%
        select(sample_name, LRTI_adjudication),
      by = "sample_name"
    ) %>%
    relocate(
      LRTI_adjudication,
      .after = sample_name
    )
  
  # Save predictions
  write.csv(
    rf_preds,
    file.path(
      results_dir,
      paste0(classifier_name, ".csv")
    ),
    row.names=F
  )
  
  return(cv_list)
}






# 4.3. Run all RF classifiers


# Full LASSO classifier
cv_lasso <- run_rf_classifier(
  selected_coefs = lasso_fold_coefs,
  classifier_name = "lassoRF_preds"
)

# LASSO n = 3 classifier
cv_lasso_n3 <- run_rf_classifier(
  selected_coefs = lasso_fold_coefs_n3,
  classifier_name = "lassoRF_preds_n3"
)

# LASSO n = 1 classifier
cv_lasso_n1 <- run_rf_classifier(
  selected_coefs = lasso_fold_coefs_n1,
  classifier_name = "lassoRF_preds_n1"
)






# 4.4. Single-biomarker classifiers


# Import ENSG-to-gene-symbol mapping
ensg2gene <- read.csv(
  file.path(raw_data_dir, "host_gene_counts.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F
) %>%
  select(X, gene_symbol)


# Identify ENSG IDs for FABP4 and ISG15
fabp4_ensg <- ensg2gene %>%
  filter(gene_symbol == "FABP4") %>%
  pull(X)

isg15_ensg <- ensg2gene %>%
  filter(gene_symbol == "ISG15") %>%
  pull(X)


# Safety checks
stopifnot(length(fabp4_ensg) == 1)
stopifnot(length(isg15_ensg) == 1)

stopifnot(fabp4_ensg %in% colnames(X_all))
stopifnot(isg15_ensg %in% colnames(X_all))


# Create fold-specific FABP4 selection
fabp4_coefs <- data.frame(
  gene_symbol = rep("FABP4", nfolds),
  gene = rep(fabp4_ensg, nfolds),
  coef = NA,
  fold = seq_len(nfolds),
  stringsAsFactors=F
)


# Create fold-specific ISG15 selection
isg15_coefs <- data.frame(
  gene_symbol = rep("ISG15", nfolds),
  gene = rep(isg15_ensg, nfolds),
  coef = NA,
  fold = seq_len(nfolds),
  stringsAsFactors=F
)


# FABP4 classifier
cv_fabp4 <- run_rf_classifier(
  selected_coefs = fabp4_coefs,
  classifier_name = "lassoRF_preds_FABP4"
)


# ISG15 classifier
cv_isg15 <- run_rf_classifier(
  selected_coefs = isg15_coefs,
  classifier_name = "lassoRF_preds_ISG15"
)






# 4.5. Collect RF votes


# Function to collect OOB probabilities
collect_rf_votes <- function(cv_list) {
  
  bind_rows(
    lapply(cv_list, function(x) {
      as.data.frame(x$mod$votes) %>%
        tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_name") %>%
        mutate(
          test_fold = x$test_fold,
          pred = .data[["Definite"]]
        ) %>%
        select(
          test_fold,
          sample_name,
          pred
        )
    })
  ) %>%
    left_join(
      metadata_df_with_folds %>%
        select(sample_name, LRTI_adjudication),
      by = "sample_name"
    ) %>%
    relocate(
      LRTI_adjudication,
      .after = sample_name
    )
}

# Collect votes for each classifier
rf_votes <- collect_rf_votes(cv_lasso)

rf_votes_n3 <- collect_rf_votes(cv_lasso_n3)

rf_votes_n1 <- collect_rf_votes(cv_lasso_n1)

rf_votes_FABP4 <- collect_rf_votes(cv_fabp4)

rf_votes_ISG15 <- collect_rf_votes(cv_isg15)

stopifnot(

    file.path(results_dir, "lassoRF_preds.csv")
  )) == nrow(metadata_df_with_folds)
)

stopifnot(
  nrow(read.csv(
    file.path(results_dir, "lassoRF_preds_n3.csv")
  )) == nrow(metadata_df_with_folds)
)

stopifnot(
  nrow(read.csv(
    file.path(results_dir, "lassoRF_preds_n1.csv")
  )) == nrow(metadata_df_with_folds)
)

stopifnot(
  nrow(read.csv(
    file.path(results_dir, "lassoRF_preds_FABP4.csv")
  )) == nrow(metadata_df_with_folds)
)

stopifnot(
  nrow(read.csv(
    file.path(results_dir, "lassoRF_preds_ISG15.csv")
  )) == nrow(metadata_df_with_folds)
)


# Confirm biomarker features are present
stopifnot(fabp4_ensg %in% colnames(X_all))
stopifnot(isg15_ensg %in% colnames(X_all))
